Order Jewelry Pricing Widget

Get a custom jewelry pricing widget for your site. It’s free to use, or upgrade to Widget Pro for no attribution and direct inquiries to you.

How it works for a jewelry retailer

  1. Visit /widgets.html and choose the free “Powered by CaratBase” widget or the pro version.
  2. Copy the embed code into your page.
  3. Your customers can instantly calculate diamond, gold, and gemstone prices.
  4. If you select Widget Pro, the widget shows a custom call‑to‑action button that sends inquiries straight to your contact form.

The widget is built from CaratBase’s 250+ reference pages and 37 ring sizes across 5 systems. No account is required.

What you get / cost / limits

  • Free version: $0, includes a “Powered by CaratBase” line.
  • Widget Pro: $12 / month per domain, no attribution, custom call‑to‑action.
  • No hidden fees.
  • The widget is fully responsive and works on all devices.

FAQ

Question? *Can I use the widget on a mobile site?* Yes. The widget is responsive and works on smartphones and tablets.

Question? *Do I need to sign up for an account?* No. You can embed the widget immediately without creating an account.

Question? *Will the widget show my brand name?* The free widget includes a “Powered by CaratBase” line. Widget Pro removes this line and lets you add your own branding.

Order your jewelry pricing widget now
